newsitem.title: UK: Unichem to lift earnings with Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Unichem to lift earnings with Lloyds.

text.p: British drugs wholesaler and retailer Unichem Plc defended its bid for Lloyds Chemists Plc on Friday, saying a merger of the two companies would "deliver an enhanced earnings stream".
Earlier its German bid rival Gehe AG attacked Unichem's offer in a letter to the shareholders of the two British companies, saying an acquisition by Unichem held "substantial risks".

In a statement, Unichem chief executive Jeff Harris said Gehe "recognises the benefits of combining Unichem's business with Lloyds' and that is why time after time it has tried to paint a negative picture about our bid".
Harris said the combination "is expected to deliver an enhanced earnings stream for shareholders and to deliver value".
Unichem is expected to announce on Monday how many accceptances it has received for its offer so far. The second closing of its offer was at 1500 GMT on Friday.
The value of Unichem's offer, which is composed of shares and cash, has fallen with Unichem's share price in recent weeks.
Gehe's offer is composed entirely of cash. Both companies have until January 17 to raise their bids.
